title: Jude and the Witness
author: Elodie Reyes
blurb: Dominic Iversen, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
